title: US Home Sales Decline Amid High Prices and Mortgage Rates
summary: Existing home sales in the US decreased by 1.7% in July. This decline is attributed to record-high prices and elevated mortgage rates, which are deterring potential buyers. First-time homebuyers constituted 29% of sales in July, indicating a significant impact on market accessibility. The inventory of homes also fell during this period.
summary_points: US existing home sales fell 1.7% in July.
Record high prices and mortgage rates are cited as reasons for the decline.
First-time buyers represented 29% of sales in July.
Home inventory decreased during the month.
